name: Inosaki Mako
source:
She is a sporty girl who belongs to the volleyball club.

She is so manly that she is popular among the female students. However, inside she is very girly, enjoys cooking, handicrafts, and loves flowers.

Her future dream is to become a bride.

[From [url=http://www.ole-m.net/saimin/index.html]official site[/url]]
